work.title: Skovsang
Song of the Woods
Vi vandre sammen Arm i Arm

history.p: This song became extremely popular during Gade's own life time. It was published in several editions and arrangements for both mixed chor, equal voices and voice and piano (for further information see GW 10:4/1 pp. 201-202).

incipText.p: Vi vandre sammen Arm i Arm

physDesc.physMedium: 1 folded folio. Written in ink. Paper: 14 staves. On fol.v staves 1-6. Heading: "Skovsang". At the end of the music dated: "Maj 1841".

annot.p: In the same manuscript as sketches for "Liden Kirsten" (NWGW 307), "Violerne" (NWGW 310), and "Spansk Sang" (NWGW 311).
